descripcion: I.6 · LLAMAN A LA PUERTA: JOHN SNOW. El cierre del Acto I. Snow no trae la respuesta: trae una libreta y una pregunta. El plano es el que hizo el jugador.
_compresion_historica: Compresión: Snow y Whitehead no se conocieron esta noche (fue en 1854-55); se declara al final.
_guion: Texto del Guion jugable del Acto I.

presenta.texto: Doctor John Snow. Forgive the hour.

el_nombre.texto: I know the name. You are the man who puts people to sleep for operations.

el_registro.texto: I heard you had been keeping a record. May I see it?

cerca_de_la_bomba.texto: These deaths lie near the Broad Street pump. And you have written down where each house fetched its water.

lo_estan.texto: I have. Most of them from that pump.

el_agua.texto: I think the water deserves the blame.

opciones.texto: A smell has a centre too. This could be a map of the smell.
If it is water, why has it spared houses beside the pump?

perdonadas.texto: Some of them, yes. I cannot tell you why yet.

silencio.texto: You do not agree with me.

objecion.texto: A smell has a centre too, Doctor. If something rotten lies beneath that corner, the deaths would thin out from it in this shape.

no_elige.texto: You are right. This map does not choose between us.

pide_aire.texto: So show me something the air cannot explain. Someone who breathed it every day, and did not fall ill.

pide.boton: Show him a card from your notebook.

aire_cerveceria.texto: Seventy men, in the middle of it, and none of them dead. The air did not pass them by.

aire_asilo.texto: 535 people, a street from the pump, and five dead. If the air did this, it would have taken more than a hundred of them.

aire_casera.texto: Eleven people under one roof, and no one dead. Did the air go round that house?

no_sirve_aire.texto: That does not show me what I asked for. Someone who breathed that air every day, and did not fall ill.

pide_lejos.texto: And the other way round. Someone who never breathed that air, and still died.

pide.boton: Show him a card from your notebook.

lejos_hampstead.texto: Hampstead. Miles from here, and she had not set foot in Soho for months. She died in the same week, of the same thing.

no_sirve_lejos.texto: That does not show me what I asked for. Someone who was never in this street, and still died.

la_pregunta.texto: Then what do we look for?

variantes.texto: Then the air cannot explain either of them. What can?

el_agua_otra_vez.texto: Every house that drank from that pump, and every house that did not. Who fell ill, and who did not. We count them all.

trabajo.texto: Then we have work to do.

la_prueba.texto: We do. We start tomorrow, at the pump.

_pivote: Snow pide pruebas y se le enseñan fichas. Lo del asilo sale de asilo_sin_muertes.
